name: ecommerce-app-be
description: Ecommerce app backend: the second example product, a NestJS monorepo (npm workspaces under apps/*) shaped like nivo-backend - each capability deployed as its own service (identity, order) instead of one src/, proving the Work layout survives a multi-repo-at-product / monorepo-inside-each-repo topology. Ports come from the one runtime projection this repository owns: metadata.json.
